content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to CAPM Certification in Atlanta

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your CAPM Eligibility
steps_items.text: CAPM requires only a secondary degree and completion of foundational project management education—no prior work experience needed. This makes the credential accessible to career-changers and early-stage professionals entering Atlanta's logistics, IT, and construction sectors. Verify your educational background meets PMI standards before enrollment.

steps_items.heading: Complete 23 Hours of PM Education
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led boot-camp course. Our intensive format condenses essential CAPM knowledge into a focused schedule, allowing you to balance certification training with your current job. All sessions are delivered online, so you can participate from anywhere in the Atlanta area.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After finishing coursework, create your PMI account and submit your CAPM application directly to the Project Management Institute. You'll provide proof of your secondary degree and course completion. Review all requirements carefully and pay the associated PMI exam fee when you apply.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Pass the CAPM Exam
steps_items.text: Granite PM Academy provides exam-preparation resources and guidance to reinforce core competencies. Schedule your proctored exam through PMI and take the assessment at your chosen testing center or online. Our instructors remain available to answer final-stage questions and build your confidence.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your CAPM Credential
steps_items.text: CAPM certification is valid for three years. Maintain your credential by earning professional development units through PMI-approved training, volunteering, or professional contributions. Plan your PDU strategy early so renewal is seamless when your cycle ends.

fq_items.question: Do I need project management experience to take the CAPM?
fq_items.answer: No prior PM experience is required. The CAPM only requires secondary education (high school diploma or equivalent) and 23 contact hours of project management education — which our course fulfills.

fq_items.question: Is the CAPM a good starting credential for {city} professionals?
fq_items.answer: Yes. The CAPM is one of the most recognized entry-level PM credentials and is highly regarded across industries in {city_state}. It demonstrates PM knowledge to employers even before you have years of experience.

fq_items.question: How does the CAPM differ from the PMP?
fq_items.answer: The PMP requires 36–60 months of project leadership experience; the CAPM does not. Many professionals earn the CAPM early in their career, gain experience, then pursue the PMP.

fq_items.question: Is this training delivered online?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Our CAPM training is fully live-virtual — no travel required. {city} students attend via video conference from wherever they are.

fq_items.question: Is CAPM certification worth pursuing for Atlanta project managers?

CAPM is recognized as a credible entry point for building a project management career; many Atlanta professionals use it as a stepping stone toward PMP. The credential demonstrates foundational knowledge and commitment, giving you measurable leverage in a competitive local job market.

Construction and fintech firms also recognize the credential. Verify current postings on Atlanta job boards to confirm demand in your specific sector.
